name: walteryr2
caption:
CAN WALTER SHOOT NOW? 🎮🏀 We drafted Ja'Kobe Walter to shoot. As a rookie, he hit 34.9% from three.

• Rookie year (2024-25): 40.5% from the field, 34.9% from three
• Year 2 (2025-26): 44.6% from the field, 40.9% from three
• Turnovers cut in half: 1.0 a game to 0.5
• Year 3: 8 starts in our first 10 games, 22 points on 5-of-8 threes at Minnesota

Breakout year, or is this who he is? 👇
